headline: Creative Newtech announces AGM voting results
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The disclosure covers the formal adoption of resolutions placed before shareholders at the meeting. For an Indian retail investor, routine procedural filings like AGM outcomes offer standard corporate governance updates but carry no immediate impact on stock price or earnings.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance update with no financial impact.

headline: CNL releases scrutiniser report on remote e-voting for 22nd AGM
summary: CNL has submitted the scrutiniser's report issued by M/s Satyajit Mishra & Co. regarding the remote e-voting conducted for the businesses transacted at its 22nd Annual General Meeting. The report details the voting results on resolutions presented to shareholders. Routine corporate compliance filings of this nature have minimal impact on stock price movement. Indian retail shareholders can review the voting outcomes on company portals for corporate governance insights.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural filing with no immediate price impact.

headline: Creative Newtech holds annual general meeting
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has informed the stock exchange about the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. Such disclosures are standard regulatory filings required by the NSE for listed companies. This procedural update carries no immediate financial impact for retail shareholders. It represents routine compliance rather than a material business event.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on share price or investor portfolio.
